step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identify external entry points: NHS users access via the N3/HSCN network (UserConsumerWeb/OnPremDC) into DirectConnect (DX). Primary and Social Care systems (OnPremDC) upload local document content via AWS Storage Gateway.
2. Trace structured data path: DirectConnect routes requests to the Integration Service (EC2 microservice with RDS). It forwards structured requests to the FHIR Service (EC2 microservice with RDS).
3. Trace unstructured document path: Storage Gateway mirrors content directly into S3. S3 triggers SQS, which invokes AWS Lambda. Lambda triggers the Document Service (EC2 with RDS), which manages document metadata and interacts with S3 for document content.

graph.name: Kainos Healthcare Interoperability Platform
graph.notes: Architecture showing processing of both structured clinical FHIR data and unstructured medical documents.

nodes.name: NHS Users (N3 / HSCN Network)
nodes.notes: Healthcare and social care clinicians accessing patient records

nodes.name: AWS Direct Connect (DX)
nodes.notes: Secure dedicated connection from N3/HSCN network into AWS

nodes.name: Integration Service
nodes.notes: Microservice handling incoming clinician search requests

nodes.name: Integration Service RDS
nodes.notes: PostgreSQL RDS storing integration service data

nodes.name: FHIR Service
nodes.notes: Microservice normalizing medical data into HL7 FHIR format

nodes.name: FHIR Service RDS
nodes.notes: PostgreSQL RDS storing normalized FHIR patient records

nodes.name: Primary Care & Social Care
nodes.notes: Care settings generating unstructured documents (discharge letters, clinic summaries)

nodes.name: AWS Storage Gateway
nodes.notes: Bridges local file systems to cloud storage

nodes.name: AWS Lambda
nodes.notes: Processes document events and triggers Document Service workflow

nodes.name: Document Service
nodes.notes: Microservice processing document metadata and content retrieval

edges.notes: User request routed through N3 network to Direct Connect
Direct Connect routes traffic to Integration Service
Integration service reads/writes state to PostgreSQL RDS
Integration service hands off request to FHIR Service
FHIR Service persists normalized data in Postgres RDS
Primary and Social care systems send documents to Storage Gateway
Storage Gateway mirrors content into S3
New S3 object triggers event message into SQS
SQS message triggers Lambda processing function
Lambda initiates business process on Document Service
Document Service writes metadata to PostgreSQL RDS
Document Service reads/writes document content from S3
